## What's Changed
### New Features 🎉
* Remove Minimum Fields by @LePips in https://github.com/jellyfin/Swiftfin/pull/2248
* Setting to Hide Poster Labels by @JPKribs in https://github.com/jellyfin/Swiftfin/pull/2249

* Convert Item `ActionButtonHStack` to Mirror Video Player by @JPKribs in https://github.com/jellyfin/Swiftfin/pull/2202
* Add `jellyfin` scheme for deep links by @LePips in https://github.com/jellyfin/Swiftfin/pull/2268
* Update Jellyfin SDK by @LePips in https://github.com/jellyfin/Swiftfin/pull/2267

* tvOS Filters by @JPKribs in https://github.com/jellyfin/Swiftfin/pull/2321
* Live TV Recording by @JPKribs in https://github.com/jellyfin/Swiftfin/pull/2146
* Poster overlay indicator styling, accessibility by @LePips in https://github.com/jellyfin/Swiftfin/pull/2334
* tvOS App Icon Selection by @JPKribs in https://github.com/jellyfin/Swiftfin/pull/2340
* Update video player state, aspect fill w/ notch by @LePips in https://github.com/jellyfin/Swiftfin/pull/2326
* Replace `NativePlayer` with `AVMediaPlayerProxy` by @JPKribs in https://github.com/jellyfin/Swiftfin/pull/2046
* Video pinch zoom by @LePips in https://github.com/jellyfin/Swiftfin/pull/2356
* Shared item store by @LePips in https://github.com/jellyfin/Swiftfin/pull/2327
* Show “Ends at” time in the video player by @jingx23 in https://github.com/jellyfin/Swiftfin/pull/2369
* Vertical episode list  by @VictoriaKGN in https://github.com/jellyfin/Swiftfin/pull/2371
* Focus User/AddUser on Start by @JPKribs in https://github.com/jellyfin/Swiftfin/pull/2383
* Playback intents by @LePips in https://github.com/jellyfin/Swiftfin/pull/2382
* Admin Dashboard - Plugins by @JPKribs in https://github.com/jellyfin/Swiftfin/pull/2373
* Adaptive layout by @LePips in https://github.com/jellyfin/Swiftfin/pull/2394
* Add previous/next chapter buttons to the video player by @jakee417 in https://github.com/jellyfin/Swiftfin/pull/2376
* Duo tabletop by @LePips in https://github.com/jellyfin/Swiftfin/pull/2401
### Bug Fixes 🛠
* Align special feature labels by @kmishukov in https://github.com/jellyfin/Swiftfin/pull/2207
* Fix filter bar following finger during navigation pop by @atirna in https://github.com/jellyfin/Swiftfin/pull/2255
* Player Overlay Button Fixes by @JPKribs in https://github.com/jellyfin/Swiftfin/pull/2216
* Fix user button disappearing by @LePips in https://github.com/jellyfin/Swiftfin/pull/2270
* Fix playback of in-progress live tv recordings by @nintwentydo in https://github.com/jellyfin/Swiftfin/pull/2262
* Fix tvOS episode state card corner radius by @oskarkasprzyk in https://github.com/jellyfin/Swiftfin/pull/2272
* Fix tvOS item overview title and navigation by @oskarkasprzyk in https://github.com/jellyfin/Swiftfin/pull/2279
* Allow `DirectPlay` for Remote Live TV by @JPKribs in https://github.com/jellyfin/Swiftfin/pull/2283
* Nested Edit Glass by @JPKribs in https://github.com/jellyfin/Swiftf

detail.readme:
Swiftfin

Swiftfin is a modern video client for the Jellyfin media server.

## ⚡️ Download ## 🛠️ TestFlight Use the TestFlight version to test new features and bug fixes before being published to the App Store. We are grateful for your time and resources for reporting new bugs. ## 📖 Documentation Swiftfin provides detailed documentation to help you understand key aspects of the app and its development approach: - [🎞️ Library Support](https://github.com/jellyfin/Swiftfin/blob/main/Documentation/libraries.md) — Information on library compatibility and supported media types in Swiftin. - [🎬 Media Playback](https://github.com/jellyfin/Swiftfin/blob/main/Documentation/players.md) — Learn about Swiftfin's playback. - [🧩 OS Version Support](https://github.com/jellyfin/Swiftfin/blob/main/Documentation/version.md) — Read about how we determine the minimum supported OS and which versions of iOS & tvOS are supported. - [🐞 Common Issues](https://github.com/jellyfin/Swiftfin/blob/main/Documentation/common_issues.md) — If you are experiencing an issue with Swiftfin, this is the best place to start. - [💜 Supporting Development](https://jellyfin.org/docs/general/contributing/direct-donations) — Learn how you can support project development. ## ⚙️ Development Thank you for your interest in Swiftfin! Please check out the [Contribution Guidelines](https://github.com/jellyfin/Swiftfin/blob/main/Documentation/contributing.md) to get started. ## 📚 Translations **Don't see Swiftfin in your language?** Check out our [Weblate instance](https://translate.jellyfin.org/projects/swiftfin/) to help translate Swiftfin and other Jellyfin projects.
